notes.title: Servers closing temporarily
notes.content:
Hello survivors!

Servers for the Open Beta 0.2 will remain closed from now on. After detecting some important issues on the matchmaking for the 3v3 Last Team Standing mode we decided to address the problem and work to find a solution ASAP. 

As you may know, Duels have been working okay since our Alpha launch but LTS have proven to be way more complex in terms of getting players in and out in certain conditions: when new survivors join a match in the middle of a fight the server doesn’t automatically update their state. That combined with other special conditions like afk, selecting a character and waiting for new players to come into the lobby generates some bugs. Even if all the players are already in the lobby the system doesn’t display the correct information and that causes confusion. 

Working on authoritative servers can be tricky and we have to nail it in order to offer the best gaming experience. We have been working on a solution for the last few weeks and hope to release a new version soon. 

See you on the battlefield.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hello survivors!

Since part of the team is still working to release the new version of our matchmaking system the machine hasn’t stopped working and we are developing at full steam!

Part of the problem we are addressing is the code architecture: although the system works, the code wasn’t as scalable as we wanted it to be so we decided to spend some extra time fixing that. For the last few weeks, we have been removing old lines of code, refactoring some of the existing systems and making the development more agile for our programming team. 

This part of the job is almost invisible for the player but it is definitely worth it when it comes to scaling the project, update features and fix bugs. Spending time refactoring the architecture design - especially on big projects like Skara - will allow us to release new content more easily and quickly down on the road. 

As of today, this work is already showing nice results: after refactoring the data model and the login process we have dramatically reduced the loading times up to 80%. Creation of new characters is now more agile and efficient. The new skill modular system allows our designers to quickly prototype new Signs and combine them with other gameplay features to offer new ways to play the game. 

And that is precisely the main feature our design team is working on for the last 2-3 months: new characters, types of attacks, skills and game roles. In order to build a nice team fighting experience, we needed a wider variety of roles on the battlefield: pure healers and support characters, skills that can be combined with other characters to create powerful combos, even archers to strike on your enemies from distance! We can’t wait to show you all these new features. 

Meanwhile, our art team has been working on new cool stuff to make your survivors look cooler than ever! We have been also working on a new arena called Atash - if you have recently checked some of our streams on Twitch you will already know what are we talking about. 

See you on the battlefield.

notes.title: Open Beta 0.2.0 is live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/29ba9b7816940e995f42d869537b23d24cdebf4b.jpg[/img]

Greetings survivors, and welcome once again to a brand new version of SKARA!

First of all, we would like to thank each and every one of you for your patience and feedback - without you, we wouldn’t be able to release what we think it’s the best version of the game the world has seen. 

We believe we are finally on the right track for a future final release of this game. Nevertheless, we believe in the constant improvement of our product, so expect patches and new updates to guarantee the best overall experience.

We’ve been working hard to solve issues of previous builds and also add new and exciting features that you can finally try out! The new update has seen the following improvements:

[h1]New feature: Daily quests[/h1]

Periodic objectives are common in a lot of games, but we wanted to add a special flavor to them in Skara. Players told us that the level of progress felt too slow, so the newly added Daily Quests allow you to gain experience faster and acquire those tasty Zem Orbs more often while you achieve specific goals - “Win 4 games as a Tamvaasa”, for instance. We want everyone to have some cool stuff to wear!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/f6bbef509c4b2b511be95f53e89175b19991df8f.png[/img]

[h1]Rework + New cosmetics: Victory poses[/h1]

We know winning is among the most satisfying feelings in Skara… But what if you could customize the way your character looks on the winning screen? Introducing Victory Poses, a fancy set of animation you can unlock in order to add a special touch to the end match screens.

Each class has now 4 Victory Poses available in the Armory. The first one comes by default - meaning that everyone will have them from day one - so make sure you unlock and equip the others to stand out from the crowd.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/3d72eb6102604dce730a85e695a98512e9630e6c.png[/img]

[h1]Game balance[/h1]

Hearing your feedback about the gameplay and character balance is one of the most strict rules we have here in the Skara studio, so we have come with A LOT of changes on the combat balancing. We focused mainly on strengthening each class’ role to try and make team compositions more interesting and, of course, fair.

Check out all the changes in the link below, detailed as never before, so you can be aware of every small change we made and take your fighting performance to the next level. 

[url=https://playskara.com/open-beta-0-2-patch-notes/]https://playskara.com/open-beta-0-2-patch-notes/[/url]

[h1]Other improvements and major bugs fixes[/h1]

Gameplay is not the only important feature on an online game: at the end of the day, the user experience has to be right. We have been putting a lot of effort on improving the UI flow, bring some new features to make life easier when navigating the menus and killing some nasty bugs that had been travelling with us for a while now. 

Interface and HUD improvements
- A scene for the Orb has been added.
- Several interface bugs were identified and fixed. Nevertheless, we believe in constant improvement in order to achieve the best version of the game yet, so expect more bug fixing in the upcoming builds.
- We are taking our first steps into a global strategy of creating a friendly and healthy environment for our community. Therefore we are implementing specific naming restrictions for account creation.

[i]See you on the battlefield,[/i] 
The Skara team

notes.title: Skara Beta is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/1293aadc55862f27a25c45eab92f1aeb2e666255.jpg[/img]

Welcome, survivors!

The moment has arrived: Skara Beta is finally live!

Thanks to all of you for your patience and the support messages we have received through the process of building Skara - The Blade Remains. There are still a lot of things that need to be done, but we truly believe that this version represents the core of our vision to create competitive multiplayer fighting and evolving storytelling. 

Here you can find what Skara Beta represents: 

[h1]Gameplay improvements[/h1]

In terms of gameplay, the main focus for this version have been to make combat more tactical and usable and to normalize certain rules that were not deterministic enough. Strongly committed to “easy to play, hard to master”, we are aiming to raise the skill cap of Skara - The Blade Remains while lowering its learning curve.

[b]Damage collision detection[/b]

We have deeply improved our system to give not only more consistency to it, but to expand the specificities of each attack. With this changes, you will want to think whether you dash left or right to avoid that wide spear attack.

[b]New combat animations + timings[/b] 

Combat timings and distances have been rebalanced to promote a slower but more diverse and tactical combat where choices are more meaningful and attacks and survivors have more variety between them.

[b]Feints[/b]

Following the timing changes we have added the feint action, which allows to stop certain starter attacks, deepening the mind games and tactics involved in the fight.

[b]Magnet and auto-lock (Free Camera Mode)[/b]

Magnet option reorients your attacks towards closest enemies to make it easier for you to hit them when you are in free camera mode. As some of you asked, you can turn it off in the options menu if it doesn’t match your playstyle.

We have also added the auto lock feature that locks a target automatically after attacking them. It only works if magnet is activated and you are in free camera mode.

[b]Smart target (Targeting mode)[/b]

Does switching between enemies when you are in targeting mode feel too slow for you? With smart target now you will be able to attack in the direction you wish (WASD or L-Stick). Try it out and give us your feedback!

[b]Deflects[/b]

Getting your attack parried or smashing your weapon against a wall will now interrupt you and play a deflect animation.

[b]Dashs rework[/b]

Dashes timing and distances have been reworked to make them more systemic and balanced.

[b]New Coliseum layout [/b]

The Khilma Coliseum has been modified to avoid unnecessary lengthening of the rounds. Having an obstacle will discourage uninteresting patterns while giving room to wider variety of interactions. It has also received a Sudden Death feature just like Gao-Di map, hope it blazes you!

[b]Dà-shizu new kit[/b]

Dà-shizu have received a full rework on their combat kit, with the goal to maintain their core traits while trying to remove some unhealthy patterns. Dashes no longer go through other players and basic and specialized attacks are now more diverse to offer deeper and more appealing options. Defense has been fully overhauled and is now a defensive attack.


[h1]Menu new look[/h1]

One of the first things you will notice is the complete rework on the main menu and the UI. Although it looks way better now this is not only a visual style change. New design layout make the process of navigating through the menu easier for both mouse and controller. 

This change will allow us to implement new features faster, as we implemented a new system to make more changes without having to create a new build. More on this to come soon. 


[h1]New cosmetics: Skins dyes[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/fbf2188d648001bc4c66ae717303422708ae46cb.png[/img]

We know the way your characters look is important, so we decided to give you even more options to distinguish yourself from other survivors on the battlefield!

Dyes will be obtained on Orbs that you can buy or unlock by just playing Skara. They all come with Lore-related names so make sure you find the best fit for your character. 

[h1]New cosmetics: Emotes[/h1]

A new way to express yourself on the battlefield has arrived! Use emotes to greet your folks and foes, or just sit down if there is an interesting duel and you don’t want to intervene. These emotes are very Lore-focused; for all of you who have read the novel ‘Time of the Two Suns’ they will be quite clear. If that is not the case stay tuned as we will soon release extra information on our Wiki page. 

At the moment there are 3 different emotes per characters. Make sure you use the in-game Communication wheel to display them on the battlefield pressing ‘B’ on your keyboard or the arrow ‘up’ on your controller. 

[h1]New skins[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/fdc41ceb4adbdaf0de06e026ff27dc89244ae4e6.png[/img]

You will find new skins, helmets and weapons available in the Armory. From the Loút Hunters from the Khärn to the amazing skin of the Klarawatch of the Tamvaasa. Find them all under each culture section and try to get them all!. 

More skins are coming on future builds. Stay tuned to Steam, Discord and all our Social Media platforms as we showcase them. 

[h1]Ingame economy[/h1]

The economy of Skara comes with major changes as we are approaching the complete integration with the blockchain. 

· Karats, the old gem that allowed you to purchase your favorite items now are called ‘Shards’. They works almost exactly the same way than the old ‘Karats’, with some extra bonus - you can now obtain some of the opening ‘Zem Orbs’. The existing ‘Karats’ in your account have been now turned to ‘Shards’. 

· The official currency in Skara is now called Talon (T) - from the House of Talé, the Kings of Durno - and it is the crypto currency of the Skara Universe. 1,000 Talons equal 1 SKRT (Skara Token), and you will be soon be able to obtain this crypto currency both in and outside the game. Check skaratoken.com for more information. 

[h1]Experience Wipe[/h1]

Experience and levels have been reset on all accounts - something quite common on Alpha-to-Beta transitions - but don’t worry: all the items you purchased during the Alpha are still in your inventory, and same goes with your ‘Karats’ (you should have exactly the same amount on ‘Shards’. 

[i]See you on the Battlefield,[/i] 
The Skara Team

notes.title: Skara is heading Beta!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/a60afe6567a26ca7a1f8b8acfb5db220d2d6fcc9.jpg[/img]

We’ve been quite silent for the last few weeks since we closed servers at the beginning of September and I want to personally apologize to all of you. We have faced several important challenges on the development side and a lot of decisions had to be made.
 
Since we launched Build 0.8.1 we have been working on major changes and improvements on the combat system side. That includes animations, timings, combo windows and a couple of nice features we have already talked about - feints, for example. These will add a new complexity layer to the way every warrior in Skara approaches a fight.
 
Unfortunately, the animations are not 100% ready yet.
 
Adding weight to the attacks has proven to be quite a challenge for our small animation team, and we didn’t want to rush things! Lots of quick iterations are being made to be 100% sure the combat feel is right. Animation sets for Celea and Tamvaasa are pretty much done but completing the sets for Kharn and Shinse is taken longer than we expected. Once you try them you will understand the amount of work required to make combat work.
 
Meanwhile, the rest of the team completed their tasks for 0.9 and are already working on features and content for Beta 1.0. So, the main decision was what to do with Build 0.9, since once the programmers start working on new features for Beta launch there is no turning back.
 
The decision, while painful, is the only logical one: we have decided to aim for a spectacular Beta launch and not release - for the moment - the Open Alpha 0.9 version. We want this launch to be perfect. Based in our experience, it is better to slow down a launch instead of releasing incomplete content and I know most of you think the same way.
 
What I can promise is that we will immediately get back to community actions, releasing constant updates about the state of Skara’s development. You can find me on Discord or ask here in Steam and I will immediately get back to you. All the changes we are making in the game have followed you feedback and this will never change. 


See you on the battlefield, 
[i]Pablo and the Skara team[/i]

notes.title: Open Alpha Patch 0.8.1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/79c52deae19812d4cce3dce585094cfffa24245c.jpg[/img]

Welcome again, survivors!
 
We are ready to introduce the new Open Alpha Patch 0.8.1. We have been working on the [b]performance of the game, as well as on adding some features, on character balancing and on some small improvements in all our maps[/b].
 
The changes in this new build include:
 
[h1]New features:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Video options menu
    [*]Added texture streaming to improve loading performance
[/list]
 
[h1]Character balancing:[/h1]
[b]Khärn[/b]: [i]He needed a minor tweak to its basic attacks as the combination of multiple Khärns in LTS modes were too powerful. The damage reduced was compensated with an improvement of his Dash Attacks, that are now more effective. We are aware that this may affect duels more than we intended, will keep tracking match results and improve it over the coming builds.[/i]
[list]
    [*]Basic Attacks damages reduced to 55/55/75 from 60/60/75
    [*]First Basic Attack Impact changed to Medium from Hard
    [*]Basic Dash Attack damage reduced to 50 from 55
    [*]Specialized Dash Attack damage reduced to 55 from 60
    [*]Solved a problem that made the Dash Attack to not connect with the enemy
[/list]
 
[b]Shinse[/b]: [i]We detected a systematic usage of the sprint attack that wasn't giving much window to counterplay to other players. To strengthen her high risk high reward mechanics we want to move that focus back to her basic and specialized attacks. Most changes influence the penalization caused by impacts, allowing for a more combo focused attacks instead of getting in and out. Given her high skill cap we will be having a look at her performance.[/i]

notes.title: Skara's Open Alpha is live!
notes.content:
The moment is finally here: today “The Time of the Two Suns” begins in Skara, and we can’t wait to hear your feedback about this Open Alpha build and event. 

This 72 hours event, called “Cataclysm” will define Skara Lore forever and will take place from today at 4:30pm CET (Central European Time) until monday 6th at 4:30pm CET . We arranged two ways for players to be part of this adventure: 

First of all, you will be able to earn rewards by reaching the top positions of our rankings. The best ranked players on each culture will be forever registered in Skara Lore as Heroes, Generals and Chiefs of those cultures. Furthermore, the best global ranked player of each day during the event will have an in-game news written by our team and will be featured in our social medias.
Second, we will turn your best plays videos into Skara Stories to be incorporated in the Skara Universe. We will share them as video stories in our Social Media channels and in-game news. 

After the event, we will keep adding pieces to Lore based on the result of the event battles. 

Now, let’s talk about current build, that has been in the making for several months now. We have been working really hard to polish the core features and to implement several things that our community asked for. Here they are! 


[h1]Social features: Play with your friends[/h1]

Please try the new social capabilities around Skara, including: 
[list]
    [*]A friends list where you can see your current ones and invite new ones.
    [*]A party system to fill with your mates to fight matches. 
    [*]A chat feature to talk with friends before, during and after matches. 
[/list]
Let us know how this new system works for you.


[h1]New Game Mode in the Lava Coliseum[/h1]

Skara has redesigned the “Free-for-All” in the Lava Coliseum to become faster, more frenetic and more tactical. Now it is called “Last Team Standing”.

The new game mode features 3v3 combat in 3 rounds. Players can only die once. The last team standing wins the round and the team that wins the most rounds wins the match.

This new game mode is brand new for our player base. Please provide us with lots of feedback! 


[h1]The return of the Khärn[/h1]

[i]Fear comes from the belly. 
So Khärn cut the belly to let it out.[/i]

The Khärn return to Skara’s battlefields with an improved look and new abilities. The most important changes are a new area attack that combine with other combo-chains and a new aggressive defense ability we call ‘Push’. They say attack is the best defense… 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/95b7adde92160c6354058cea1da12a1288710141.jpg[/img]

[h1]Changes to look out for in the Duel Arena[/h1]

Fighting in Jaarvi has changed for the better to make duels more competitive. 

Now there’s a best of five rounds system that are common in other versus fighters, instead of a single round with three lives. No more defending what is left of your remaining life after finishing an enemy off, every round begins fresh! 


[h1]New Match Flow and Matchmaking[/h1]

The Create Match process has been streamlined.
[list]
    [*]You can now play solo or with friends. You can easily create a Party with your friends from the social menu.
    [*]Survivor selection is now done before the match. Team tactics now start at the beginning of the match as you can choose the survivor that best suits your team. Team formations are key to winning.
    [*]We’ve also complete redesigned how players enter, leave and earn rewards in a match.
    [*]Re-match has been added, so you no longer have to wait long periods of time before finding a match.
[/list]

[h1]Accounts reset[/h1]

This build comes with major changes in the way we manage the accounts and the characters (now called survivors as you may have read). One of the main points is the fact that in this version you will have access to all the survivors from the beginning. In order to achieve it we needed to reset all the accounts. 
Your previously purchased cosmetic items won’t be present in your account, but don’t worry: we already gave you back the Karats you spent with some extra ones for you to repurchase the cosmetic items that you previously had or to purchase some of the new ones available!
We apologize for the inconvenients.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/05d734a1bac72c4fc4c9a74a2680213b90515a4b.jpg[/img]

We rely a lot on your feedback and can guarantee we reply to all messages, so don’t be shy and write to us on the Steam Forums, Social Media or the new Skara Forum on our website. 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Weekend event, “Cataclysm” actions[/h1]

[b]Video contest[/b]
Send us your gameplay video and become a Skara Legend. 
To do so just follow these simple steps:
1) Play Skara and record your best actions with any record software (OBS, Nvidia Shadow Play etc.). If you don’t know how to use them we have selected  [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oZUjBw3SuCY]an OBS videotutorial for you here[/url] and [url=http://www.howtogeek.com/259573/how-to-record-your-pc-gameplay-with-nvidia-shadowplay/]another Nvidia Shadow Play written tutorial here.[/url]
2) Upload your video/s on your Youtube channel (it can be private or public)
3) Just make sure to send to contact@playskara.com -A- “Best plays contest” as subject -B- your YouTube link (you can set the exact second you want us to look at it from), -C- your Skara Displayname and the -D- exact second from which you want to highlight your video (if you haven’t sent your link starting from it) 

Then, you will be eligible to have a narrated piece on our social media channels describing your character’s feats with an edited video by our own studio.

Moreover, the best survivors of each Skara Culture will appear in the “Skara Heroes’ compilation video” that we will create with the best plays. These survivors - now turned into skara heroes, will have their own role in the future Skara History that you will find in the [url=http://skara.wikia.com/wiki/Skara_Wiki]Skara Lore’s Wikia.[/url]  

We will accept video links until Wednesday the 8th at 11:59pm CET.


[b]Best “Cataclysm” ranked players[/b]

During the “Cataclysm”, each fight will give, at the end of the match, a certain amount of points depending on certain in-game criterias. You will have three ways to earn rewards:

1) If you are at the Top of our General Ranking on any of these days at the time indicated: Saturday 4th at 4:30pm CET, Sunday 5th at 4:30pm CET or Monday 6th at 4:30pm CET, we will write an in-game news about you and feature you in our social medias. 

2) If you are strong enough to reach the Top Position of one of our 4 Culture Ranking at the end of the event, monday 6th at 4:30pm CET, you will be forever registered in Skara Lore as Heroes, Generals and Chiefs of those cultures.  

3) If you reach a Top 10 Position in our general ranking at the end of the event, Monday 6th at 4:30pm CET, we will reward you with Karats (the in-game premium currency).

[i]“Then Lôm, The Maiden of the Heavens, engaged Celem in a terrible Celestial contest… and in the time it takes to draw a breath, everything was lost.”[/i]
–from the Chronicles of Durno People

Stay tuned to our Steam Page to be aware of what’s new in this version and, like always, leave your comments and feedback - we reply to all your messages!

notes.title: See Skara in 2017
notes.content:
Work continues apace on SKARA - The Blade Remains, and we promise that team-based PvP gaming will never be the same! 

We are currently finishing work on the server infrastructure, polishing the combat system, optimizing the graphics and perfecting the match-making system to insure that SKARA is the frenetic close combat multiplayer we have been dreaming about.

Want to know some details? Our team of indiedevs have supplied them below! 

[h1]Improving gameplay[/h1]

After being mainly focused on perfecting the feeling of the basic combat, we have now worked on how to add back the signs (skills).

One of the big changes we will be working on throughout the coming months is changing the scope of skills. Instead of the primary system players use to attack, they will only be an aid for the combat. Team-collaboration will be needed to make full use of them. This process is in it early stages, so when the beta is released we will look forward to your feedback.

Other changes include:
[list]
[*]Removal of any “unstoppability”: Skills can now be canceled and countered, so you better watch out for the best moment to use them, and stop them!
[*]Skill cast timings and animations have been adjusted so they match the faster pace of the combat system.
[*]Balance: Major changes to damage, range and cooldowns to fit the previous requirement.
[*]We’ve also changed how some skills work:
[*]Shinse’s Invisibility skill (“Seeming Empty”) makes her completely undetectable at long ranges.
[*]Tamvaasa’s “Vilkai Song” skill has been completely reworked… you’ll see it.
[*]Many others are still being tested… we’ll talk more about them soon.
[/list]

[h1]Improving Skara’s visuals while optimizing the game[/h1]

Last month we showed off some of the visual improvements. This month we decided to talk about how many assets we have been working on.

Here you have a simple summary table about the status of the development as of the time this post has been published:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/4361471afa2b6e520713858bbfb778661c35eccb.jpg[/img]

As you can see, we are close to finishing all the assets, finally :) 

The ones that have been following us for a while may remember that the Khärn were present in builds prior to the 0.6.0. That’s the reason why 5 assets have been reworked for this version, you will see a strong improvement!

Concerning the new cosmetics… here is one of them. We will keep the rest a secret!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/d65eb03d83ecd185d99106afaa3ce7c69cec61a2.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Match Flow and Matchmaking[/h1]

One of the main focuses right now for the design team is to make the game more “fluent” and easy to play. Menus have always been a big problem and over the coming months we’ll plan to make huge changes to them.

The First Time Experience (FTUX) of SKARA is now free (it can be skipped). You can play whatever you want with any character you want, no longer having to wait to unlock slots. Tutorial steps and other progression features are now reward-based and you can decide what to do and when to do it.

The Create Match process has been streamlined.
[list]
[*]You can now play solo or with friends. You can easily create a Squad with your friends from the social menu.
[*]Character selection is now done before the match. Team tactics now start at the beginning of the match as you can choose the character that best suits your team. Team formations are key to winning.
[*]We’ve also complete redesigned how players enter, leave and earn rewards in a match.
[*]Re-match has been added, so you no longer have to wait long periods of time before finding a match.
[*]Match presentation and endings: We are aware that some game events may not be clear, including messages of Victory/Defeat and Match presentations, so we are working hard on this area. We’ll comment more on this in future announcements.
[/list]
Those changes include massive internal alterations to matchmaking, interface, error management, including a new set of rules to penalize quitters and the possibility of rejoining a current match if players have internet problems.

As you can see - we have been very busy! We’ll keep up the hard work and let you know the release date… soon!

It has been a fantastic 2016. Can’t wait to see you on the battlefield in 2017!

[i]Pablo and the Skara Team[/i]

notes.title: Skara Dev Update: Clearing the Beta launch pad
notes.content:
It has been some weeks since our last update, but, as they say, no news is good news! Right?

It turns out there IS a lot of news to share as we work to get the game ready for a beta launch.

[b]We currently are working on four fronts:[/b]


[h1]1) Improving gameplay[/h1]

[list]
[*]Improving overall combat feeling: We are shortening the attack delay and adding tactics to enter combat and counterattack.
[*]Differentiating character-classes:
[*]Shinse are now quicker and more lethal, but are also less armored than their fellow inhabitants of Skara.
[*]Tamvassa are also quicker. They can be in the middle of a team battle formation and get in/out of combat easily.
[*]Celea are more versatile and useful at keeping enemies at range, with an improved defense.
[*]Khärn. These tank-like character have been completely reworked, but saying more would be giving it away...
[*]New Defense types: Each character-class utilize a unique defense system that suit their combat style.
[*]Better Dueling in Jaarvi: We looked at all the duels during our Alpha and used that data and your feedback to refactor the game mode.
[*]Better Melee  in the Lava Coliseum: This is a completely new game mode, instead of all against all plus a boss fight, the Lava Coliseum has become a 3vs3 fight for your (single) life… more coming soon :)
[/list]

[h1]2) Improving Skara’s visuals while optimizing the game (yes, this is actually possible!)[/h1]

We are implementing the PBR (physically based rendering) logic to all our skins. This logic is used by most AAA studios in order to improve the visual aspect of their games.

We are also updating the textures, adding more details and improving the visual quality.

Here are some examples of the improvement:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/b9f1710abb635b5580f59fd10bf0c96931102713.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/25c1f374fce3b5bf3e8a1d444bf2fcf235efdfad.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/eea33e91d8e04d6c7347eb19071a0f414fa39774.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/cb6930efd5df81e8e54d02d1df44739a1c5c4c55.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/bca296b9ea90353998e96ca1fa17113f9b154ea6.png[/img]

We are applying the same logic to our maps while reducing their geometry by half. This will optimize the game without a noticeable visual downgrade!


[h1]3) Adding to Skara’s meta-game[/h1] 

Yes, we know--one of the hardest parts of playing the alpha was a lack of social infrastructure to find friends and organize matches. The good news is Skara’s beta will have this infrastructure, including:
[list]
[*]New social mechanic features (a friends list, menu and in-game chat, grouping with your friends before joining a game, and more...)
[*]Smooth match flow, so you don’t have to wait long to get into the battle.
[*]Error control on match flow, so the game doesn’t completely fall apart while organizing matches.
{*]This plays into the game combat as well. We have dramatically improved the Parry/Defense network system making it faster and more lifelike.
[/list]

[h1]4) Here come the Khärn...[/h1]

Finally, the Khärn will be making their comeback to Skara... We can’t wait to hear what you think!

For now, here is a tease of the improvements...

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/0c95213e6fad4bdc12f0dd5740696c9c052ab380.jpg[/img]

See you on the Battlefield! 


Pablo and the Skara Team

notes.title: The Fury Road to Build 0.6.0
notes.content:
The last month before releasing a new Skara build has normally been a crazy, non-stop working spree. 

The work leading up to Build 0.6.0 was no exception.  Our programmers have been coming to the studio to work on most of the Sundays and EVERY single Saturday for the last 2 months. The amount of work that needed to be done to bring our vision of a close-combat multiplayer fighting game is humongous. 

First of all, our entire replication system had to be re-configured and adapted to the new dedicated servers. The new Skara is finally going to be available for a whole bunch of players, not just a few chosen testers. For that to work, everything had to be rock solid to avoid lag on multiplayer matches. 

Doing this may sound a little bit crazy, but is was certainly worthwhile. There are a lot of different situations that had to be reviewed and coded over again. The team had to try and consider gameplay situations from multiple perspectives to ensure that everything looked the way it should. This included situations like when a player is hit in the middle of a dodge. What animation and distance displacement should each of the players see? There is a lot of prediction involved in the code of most multiplayer games, and Skara is no exception, but that comes with thousand of hours of hard work testing, coding, compiling, and testing again. 

Ciro and David were our chosen programmers for this, while Juanma worked on the dedicated server integration. Jacobo, meanwhile, has been working on the interface logic to include player parties, in-game chat, and a social/friend system in Skara.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/e9401d4adb3abdd0930e165d74f7aeb0e6544833.jpg[/img]

Yes, that is right: Skara is being made by only 4 gameplay programmers! 

Our designers had a hard time on all these features as well. Since the whole combat system was going to be re-configured Joan - our Lead Game Designer - took advantage of the great feedback our player base provided and re-calculated distance and power for all the attacks in the game to re-adjust the character balancing. Sara and Adrià, junior part-time designers, helped him out to test and adjust each one of the blueprint and animation montages to make sure everything matched. 

The Art department meanwhile gave a warm welcome to a couple of new additions. Marc Obiols joined the team as an Environment/Materials artist, and Adrià Najar is now the Lead Artist in charge of the whole department. 

As some of you may know, the Jaarvi Duel Arena has been totally redone. Most of the animations - more than one hundred animations for each character - had to be re-adjusted to match the new gameplay and replication logic. We also seized the opportunity to connect a couple of Kinect Ones and try some motion capture for the first two in-game cinematics. You will see them the first time you open the game. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/801121a381cf4da2bd26d23a6fb8212e04d94793.jpg[/img]

Finally, we were waiting to add a lot of new cosmetic and customizable options for your characters in the game store. New complete skins, isolated items, helmets and looks will be available in Skara 0.6.0… and this is only the beginning! We are planning to release a new character customization system in version 0.7.0 to allow players to choose their character faces and skin color, individualised mockeries, and a lot more content. 

See you on the battlefield!

Pablo, Indie Pirate Developer in charge of making Skara. 
 
PS Look out for more information on the game. An announcement of the next build (including new characters, optimization AND dedicated servers) is coming soon!

notes.title: SKARA 0.5.5 IS ALIVE! (Now it bites from a distance…)
notes.content:
Skara has spent a busy and eventful year on Early Access. Thanks to your feedback, we’ve been able to improve the game dramatically. This build introduces many new levels of awesomeness, but the one we are MOST excited about are the way skills work. Within this are new range weapon skills. Now all the characters are specially equipped to fight from a distance.

Try each of them out and let us know what you think! 

[b]BUILD 0.5.5 CHANGELOG[/b]

[b]Character balancing:[/b] Khärn skills were nerfed, since the community generally claimed they were too powerful. Celea skills and damage have been reduced as well, and Shinse has been buffed. Try them out and let us know if this improves the fairness of the fights. 

[b]New skills:[/b] All character receive brand new Range Special Skills - The Celea maintain the old Disc of Sun, while the Shinse get a new Poison Kunais (a cone attack with poison buff) and the Khärn throw a giant rock! Say goodbye to the previous projectile system (that weird throwing knives- or rocks) and activate your new range skills pressing F on your keyboard or A on your controller. 

[b]New frag display:[/b] now the UI shows relevant information when you die, including who killed you and their equipped skills, your record at that particular time, and much more...

[b]New Celea skill:[/b] We are proud to Introduce Celem’s Blades, a skill that will increase the range of the spear attack with a nice touch of fire.

[b]Camera effects:[/b]  for Khärn, Shinse and Celea to feel more a part of the battle from the third-person perspective, we’ve adjusted and enhanced the camera. 

[b]Rage vortex VFX:[/b] An ability which was available for the last two versions was lacking some VFX and visual feedback, so we decided to give it a twist and implement new visual effects. 

[b]New card system for the special skills.[/b] This will change how players get their skills, let us know what you think. 

[b]New slot and HUD cooldown for the range special skills:[/b]  Now you can activate three skills during your battle! Enjoy the mayhem, and good luck staying alive...

[b]Medals:[/b] unlock new achievements every match in each of the SKARA arenas. We start with our old Coliseum. (Check out what happens if you are the player who inflicts the most damage on Groth!)

[b]A new Khärn skin:[/b] Currently only seen for the bots, this feature will soon be available for Khärn characters!

[b]New character and account-separated progression bars:[/b] Track your progress in SKARA with these new features. Let us know what you think about them.

notes.title: SKARA: One Year In – The Blade (and the Dream) Remains!
notes.content:
On October 27, Skara will have been on Steam Early Access for a whole year. That seems hard to believe—except when we really sit back and look at the progress we have made.

Our earliest backers and testers know all about it. We’ve come from one arena and one character (and a lot of bugs!) to three arenas and three characters, special skills, player accounts and rankings…and a whole lot more that players will never see or notice. And we are just getting started!

With our first anniversary upon us, it felt like it was time to celebrate our progress and the rapidly growing community.

ANNIVERSARY EVENTS:

NEW BUILD – we will release Skara. 0.5.5: Complete with a whole bunch of new features, frag display, new class skills and the new range combat special abilities, updated arenas, improved combat controls, and a whole lot more. Look at our Change Log on October 27.

TOURNAMENT—We are going to be holding the very first Skara Tournament in-studio. Players will be able to compete for the honor and glory of being the best. We sadly cannot open this up to the globe, but we will stream it (see below). 

Interested in holding your own tournament? Go for it! Keep track of the results, stream it, and send us the winner. They may get a special prize. 

TWITCH STREAM—going with our tournament, we will be livestreaming from the studio, playing matches, answering questions and just generally getting to know the player community. Expect there to be some fun and banter. BYOB!

WHILE YOU WAIT the team has started doing game development streams and live game streams more regularly. Check out our Twitch channel: http://www.twitch.tv/skarathebladeremains 
 
Look forward to seeing you October 27, and until then—see you on the battlefield!

[i]Pablo, Skara Indie Pirate in chief[/i]

notes.title: Skara Version 0.5.4 is LIVE
notes.content:
It was another hot summer sweating next to the server fan for the Skara team, but nevertheless we were able to make another step of progress. Welcome to Build 0.5.4! 

Here’s a list of the new Features found in the 0.5.4 version: 

- A new playable tutorial (including a new environment: The Khilma dungeons).
- Power up items in the arenas (specifically health power ups and damage buffs).
- Try all three characters without leveling up! This is something a lot of our users requested and we were very happy to change. 
- Class skills are now attached to different buttons (Q&E on the keyboard, X and Y on Xbox controller)
- The Melee combat is faster now, the Hit stun is reduced. Also the free target mode has been modified to allow characters to dodge without losing focus on the target. 
- Rankings! Who will be the best? Find it in the War Log in the UI.
We also changed the Duel Game conditions to make it feel more like a Versus fighting game.  
- We’ve worked on the animations for all characters to make them more realistic and more spectacular. Characters should blend to sprint mode now and a lot of other features: Check them out! 
- New in-game HUD: Now you can check your enemy’s shield meter as well as the skills they’ve equipped. There’s also a new effort meter when sprinting. 
- Finally, we did a lot of Bug and crash fixing to make the game more stable. Please as usual send us feedback if something isn’t working by either writing in the forums, sending us an email, or filling out a bug report. 

Community development news. 

We know it has been difficult to find other players online, and we want to do everything we can to improve this. We can confirm there are a LOT of you out there! 

On of the issues we are facing is no budget for dedicated servers, which means players will not be able to find each other if they are not in the same general area.

This should get better once we get dedicated servers (hopefully soon!), but meanwhile the best way to find other players is to send a shout out on social media, like Twitter, Reddit, or in Steam. We have a million ideas for tackling this, but we are of course always happy to listen to you all. Remember: Sharing is caring. 

We have several more announcements coming soon, so stay tuned. And See you on the battlefield! 

Pablo and his ragtag group of indie pirate developers. ARRRRG!

notes.title: Skara Version 0.5.3 is LIVE
notes.content:
August is here and the SKARA team has been busier than ever improving the game. 

We have just released the 0.5.3 build. Instead of loading two builds, we decided to basically merge the content planned for the 0.5.2 and 0.5.3 versions into one, so we are jumping from 0.5.1 to 0.5.3 to avoid confusion. 

The result is a much bigger improvement in the game, we think. As usual, we look forward to your feedback. 

Here’s a list of the improvements to be found in the version 0.5.3
[list]
[*][b]Bug fixing:[/b] these kind of things are normally invisible but you will notice a difference.

[*]Thanks to popular demand, [b]Keybindings and Invert Y camera options are now available both in-game and in the menu settings[/b]. 
New UI 3D scene. Now your character is always visible when navigating the menus. 

[*][b]There are also new class skills for all characters:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Shinse[/b] gets Forest Wind to attack foes and escape from difficult, close-combat situations. 

[*][b]Khärn[/b] are now able to attract enemies thanks to the new ability, Rage Vortex.

[*][b]Celea[/b] can now turn their shielººd into flames and hurl it, hitting enemies from a range. It then returns, like a boomerang. 
[/list]
[*][b]We have released the first iteration for our matchmaking system.[/b] Now it is easier to join and leave matches, find people to play with and avoid crashing out. We know this has been the biggest hurdle to enjoying the game, and we are working hard to fix it. 

[*][b]New HUD:[/b] Health bar and shield bar have different behaviour and graphics now. This feature is not finished though, and we’ll implement more changes in the 0.5.4 version. 

[*][b]Durno and Tamvaasa silhouettes are now visible[/b] in the Character Selection menu... and will be coming soon!

[*][b]XP and levels have been re-factored[/b] to make progression more balanced. This will wipe out all progress made thus far… sorry about that! 

[*][b]Duels on Jaarvi are three kills based now[/b], like some Versus games you may know… :)

[/list]
This Tuesday at 5pm UK time (6pm CET, 12pm EST, 9am PST), the Skara dev team will be livestreaming the new build on Twitch. Tune in to see the new features of the game in action. 

We also look forward to hearing from players who have tried the game and anyone who has an opinion or idea about its development. get in touch with us in the forums or on social. 
See you on the Battlefield! 

Pablo and the SKARA Team

notes.title: Skara Version 0.5.1 is LIVE
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the arrival of Skara 0.5.1! This is a first glimpse at the real deal. What came before was really more like a demo. A helpful demo, where we were able to create our combat system and try out tons of features, but a demo all the same. 

[b]Now Skara feels like a game.[/b] 

Players create accounts, can choose characters and see progression. It’s a proper skeleton with some of the organs. Now we just need to add muscles and some skin--not to overdo the metaphor!

Highlight of New Features:

[b]Class skills[/b]

Every character has their own special abilities,  making gameplay a lot more fun and tactical. 

It is now possible to personalise fighting styles by picking the character and their special abilities. 

Let us know if there are any balancing issues, and generally what you think of them. 

[b]New Character: Khärn[/b]

The Khärn are more like a tank character than ever before: Slow and Strong. We definitely look forward to seeing how players use their abilities. We think they are pretty well balanced against the Celea and the Shinse, but this is something we aim to perfect.

Please feel free to stream your gameplay! This is the best way to spread the word. If you are interested in having your stream hosted on the official Skara Twitch channel, get in touch. 

Our development schedule continues apace. The last two characters are currently being modelled, we have new class skills in the works, and lots of plans for improvements to the UI and much more. 

Got a question? Want to know more? Get in touch! We are active on social media (

[url=https://twitter.com/SkaraTBR]Skara on Twitter[/url]

[url=http://skarathebladeremains.tumblr.com]Skara on Tumblr[/url] 

[url=https://www.facebook.com/SkaraTheBladeRemains]Skara on Facebook[/url] 

and will try and respond to emails sent to contact@skarathebladeremains.com

See you on the battlefield, 

Pablo

notes.title: Getting closer to an alpha state
notes.content:
Skara’s next build, version 0.4.6, is going to bring the largest bunch of features and improvements since we launched Skara on Early Access and will represent the beginning of our alpha state.

In addition to passive and special skills, the most important updates will come in the backend. Build 0.4.6 will bring player accounts, levels, experience and rankings as well as other community tools such as live chat for the lobby and in-game VoIP. 

These features have been demanded from the beginning by a lot of our pre-alpha testers and will help a lot of our players to find other people to play with and interact in-game. But it is an ambitious feature for our small team: a lot of care and dedication must be taken to avoid bugs and crashes, as well as to prevent player's accounts being hacked. But we are working hard to get there. 

The next build will also bring some cool improvements to the in-game action: We will complete the core combat mechanics for Celea and Shinse, including new features like dash attacks, parry and executions. These features still need to be proven, so don’t necessarily expect a complete list at this stage. 

We cannot confirm a release date for this new build, though we would love to launch it the beginning of May. In any event we'll announce the final date for the release soon. 

Thanks a lot to all of you who played and enjoyed our prototype and pre-alpha builds. Your feedback has been incredibly useful and your support was our main motivation to keep working hard and create an incredible multi-player experience. 

See you on the battlefield, 

Pablo from the SKARA Team

notes.title: SKARA EVOLVES: BUILD 0.4.4 IS NOW LIVE.
notes.content:
It’s time to try the new build of Skara, which represents a giant step in progress of the game development.  

Most of the updates and features described in our earlier blog post are there to try out. The only thing we had to remove at the last minute was the special area attack, which lacked balance and smooth animations, causing it to disrupt gameplay.

The SKARA Team

notes.title: IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT: NEXT BUILD DELIVERY DATE CHANGE
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

After much debate, the development team has decided to roll our next two updates into one. Faced with the choice of delivering a bug-infested build in January, or giving ourselves more time to do things the right way and publish it in February, we obviously went with the latter. 

That means several more weeks of Skara without changes to explore, but we are confident that the community would prefer good, polished content instead of shoddy, half-baked stuff we plan on improving anyway. 

So keep your spirits up! We will be able to deliver not only the optimization patch (which will allow most of you to play Skara with lower-end computers, opening up our potential player base significantly) but also most of our core game mechanics for the future.  

Those mechanics include player accounts, improved game modes, in-game notifications, and both primary and secondary objectives for you to accomplish in game arenas. We are also working on new combat mechanics and may even be ready to implement our ranged weapons system, as well as improved attacks, animations and game flow. 

All of these things should make Skara an entirely new gaming experience, and that is completely because of your help. Your feedback throughout our first months in Early Access has been crucial to getting the game to its current state. Without your suggestions and advice we wouldn’t have implemented bots, character balancing, in-game flow and a lot of other features that are there now. So on behalf of the entire team, I want to send you a HUGE THANK YOU for all the support you have given the project. Our small group of devs read EVERY post you have written about the game, as well as the reviews about Skara in our Steam Store, both positive and negative. Without you guys there wouldn’t even be a game!

Because the response to our streaming and Steam group sessions have been so incredible, we are going to have them on a weekly basis from now on. SKARA IS YOUR GAME, and we’ll address the development of Skara any direction you want to go, since it has proven itself to be a wonderful, wonderful idea and way to work on a game. 

So every Monday at 6pm UK time, we will have a developer Steam chat and every Friday we will have a developer stream, 5pm UK it will be in Spanish, 6pm in English. 

This is the crucial moment to be influencing the development of SKARA. So please, keep being active on the boards and in social media. Don’t be shy about proposing new ideas and suggesting all kind of features for Skara, even if they are crazy and unachievable - those ideas tend to generate amazing conversations related not only to Skara, but the gaming world in general. We are just gamers like you and are always happy to jump into a conversation about multiplayer game modes, movies or books. 

Again, thank you for all this support. We can’t believe how lucky we are to have a community this great behind us. We won’t let you down!

Pablo

notes.title: BUILD 0.4.3 IS NOW LIVE
notes.content:
Here’s an update on all the improvements and expansions to Skara we have been working around the clock to get out to you.

[b]New Arenas![/b]

Finally, players can get out of the suffocating Lava Coliseum and breathe some fresh air! Two new arenas will be part of the new build. (SPOILER ALERT: one of them will be hot and the other not)

These new arenas will be much bigger than the Coliseum experience, allowing players to get a feel for the larger combat scenarios we envision for the game. More space means more players at the same time, means (hopefully) more fun.

The new arenas will not be polished, leaving some room for you all to tell us what you like about them and what you would like to see changed. That’s the whole point of Early Access, right?

[b]New Character![/b]

Also at long last, Skara opens up beyond the Sons of Fire. We can finally introduce a race that consider the Celea their arch-enemies, the most ancient race in Skara—the Shinse.

We went for the polar opposite of the Celea (female, light weaponry, fast) for a reason—to try and balance the characters correctly. Some aspects of the Shinse will be rougher than others 

[i]NOTE: some animations and effects will be place holders but again, we wanted to leave room for your feedback before we started fine tuning. So please, join in the conversation.[/i]

[b]Player Lobbies![/b]

We realize one of the most frustrating part of the game is finding other players to play with, so we have set about creating a space to make it easier. With the new player lobbies, you can find your friends (or frenemies) to schedule fights.

This aspect of the game is one of the most important and (thanfully) one of the easiest to alter, so let us know what you think.

[b](Less) Lag![/b]

In the midst of this frenetic development, we have been trying to tackle core issues at the heart of the gaming experience. We are a small team and are limited by the number of hours in the day, so some of these fixes will be better than others. Players should have less lag. If you notice anything in particular about this issue, or anything else technical, tell us about it and include as many details about it as possible, including your computer specs and screenshots.

It is really helpful for us to know about problems and issues, and we know it takes time to tell us, so many thanks in advance!

[b]Closing Thoughts[/b]

So here’s a brief outline of the new update:
2 new arenas
1 new character
Player lobbies
Enhanced menu/UI
Less lag

We hope these improvements do a LOT to enhance your experience of Skara. Early Access can sometimes be a let-down, and players have to sometimes use their imaginations to see the final product. It is also a lot of fun, and honestly, we wouldn’t want to develop our game any other way.

Thanks again for joining the Skara community and see you on the battlefield!

On November 17th the latest version of Skara became available. That’s one week later than planned, but we had to spend all our time fixing bugs and waging war with the lag that players were experiencing. 

Because of that, we could release a more limited update this coming week, but we decided it would be better to work on more substantial features that really enhance the gameplay instead.

So here is the list with almost all the changes you will see in a little over one week:

[h1]0.4.1 BUILD Changelog[/h1]

· IA: Added bots to every match. If a player joins a battle, he will enter a Spectator Mode until the bot dies.
· Combat system: 
- Unstoppable attack: now it works holding X (controller) or E (keyboard)
- The unstoppable attack doesn’t consume stamina anymore. Now it has a cool-down timer, check the icon on your lower left corner. 
- Attacks and dodges are not ruled by stamina, but by penalty timings.
- Stamina will be used for sprint and block control.
- Camera moved slightly away from the player, in order to allow players to see menacing objects behind them.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam Early Access - Skara - The Blade Remains

Skara - The Blade Remains is Now Available on Steam Early Access!

notes.title: The first version of Skara (0.4.0) and LAG
notes.content:
After a long, long ride, somehow we managed to get Skara to a playable stage. What started as a side project born in the university is now close to being a proper game. But there’s still a lot of work to be done, and we want to rely on our community to get Skara to the next level and beyond. 

So, important things to notice about our Early Access launch version: It will have very limited features. Host a match or jump into a quick fight to try Skara’s newly designed combat system. Then help us to improve and balance it, we don’t want to move to the next phase until we deliver a competitive experience that fits the most demanding player. 

Then, every two weeks we’ll release new content for you to try out and provide us with feedback, propose new ideas and suggest ways to improve Skara. You can see the development Roadmap in our Store page, including the content for the upcoming two updates and our final goal: Skara’s full release.

We have been testing Skara internally, since we don’t have a budget for QA sessions, and we’ve already discovered some issues with slow connections and low-end computer specs. The game gets laggy and it’s almost impossible to play. We are working to fix that, but we need as much data as you can send us if you experience lag problems: your pc specs, your connection settings, if you are broadcasting Skara at the same time you play, etc. This is the only way we can take care of every specific case and move things to fix problems. The more of you reporting problems and laggy games, the faster we can fix the issue and improve the experience. 

[b][i]What you should take away:[/i][/b]  We do know that the game is at a very, very early stage, (especially everything involving menus, user interface and usability) but those things are easy to implement and we wanted to focus on the combat system--the most important element of gameplay. We also wanted to give the community (you!) every chance to collaborate with us to improve Skara through feedback and idea sharing. 

After all, if we release an almost completed game in Early Access, what’s left for you to develop with us?

notes.title: SKARA is your game
notes.content:
If you take a look at our development blog or our forums, you will notice that we’ve shared the development of Skara with the community from the very beginning. This decision caused us quite a few headaches: People complaining about the low quality of models and animations of early videos, people creating a wish list of features to design, etc. 

In the end we are so glad about those headaches, because it turns out what the community demanded are now Skara’s most important features! They created the faction system, they forced us to change the targeting system from automatic to manual (and the game is so much better because of it), etc.

The community has also been very active helping us out on social media, promoting our Kickstarter project, convincing friends to join our community… This game doesn’t belongs to us, Skara belongs to you. 

Although we could not be more happy with the response from the community so far, we are always looking for better and more efficient ways to communicate and interact with you, so that Skara really does feel like your game. We also want to make sure everyone’s voice gets heard. 

[b]ABOUT TRELLO[/b]
